title: Create Custom Class
description: Create a custom class for speech adaptation.

objective.narrative: Custom classes allow you to define a list of words or phrases that represent a common concept. These can then be used in PhraseSets to improve speech recognition accuracy for specific terms, such as product names or proper nouns.
